column3: DESCRIPTION
Create a new private repository and add all coaches as collaborators immediately upon repository creation.

Your repository must follow this branching model throughout development:
     • main → Production-ready branch (only branch graded)
     • dev → Integration branch; receives completed features
     • feature/* → One branch per feature
                      → Must be created from dev
                      → Must be merged back into dev when completed

🚫 No direct commits to main

Students Working in Teams: The frontend and backend must be developed in parallel. One student should work on the frontend while the other works on the backend. The commit history and branch activity must clearly demonstrate simultaneous development, not sequential work or last-minute contributions.

Students Working Solo: The backend must be developed first, followed by the frontend. The commit history and branches must clearly show that the backend was completed before the frontend development began.

Before submitting the module:
     1. All feature branches must be merged into dev
     2. The dev branch must then be merged into main
     3. The main branch must reflect the final, stable version of the project

The commit history must clearly demonstrate this workflow:
     • feature → dev → main

⚠️ Only the main branch will be graded.
